_format: Contract tests for tsql::editor::Complete (include/tsql/editor.hpp); run by tests/editor/test_completion.cpp.
Written from T-SQL semantics, not from any implementation. Catalog: catalog.json in this directory.
Case fields:
id (unique), area (report grouping), version (GrammarName: TSql130..TSql180, TSqlFabricDW),
Only area 'versions' holds version-specific cases; every other case must hold in every version (ctest
also runs them under each grammar with test_completion --as-version).
sql: the script with the caret marked by exactly one '|' (removed before calling Complete; the caret is the
UTF-8 byte offset of the '|'). Cases therefore never use the '|' operator.
mustInclude: items that must be returned; mustExclude: items that must not be returned.
Item: {kind, label[, insertText]}. kind: a CompletionKind name, or an array of acceptable kinds (in
mustExclude kind may be omitted = any kind). label matches case-insensitively; for Keyword, TableHint
and QueryHint it also matches an item whose label is a phrase starting with it ('ORDER' ~ 'ORDER BY').
insertText, when given, must equal the item's insertText exactly.
expectedReplace (optional): {start, length} in UTF-8 bytes of the caret-less sql.
topN (optional): [{kind, label, n}]: a matching item must be among the first n items.
noItems (optional): true = Complete must return no items (caret inside a comment, string or number).
currentDatabase (optional): overrides the catalog's currentDatabase for this case.
Invariants checked on every result: replaceStart <= caret <= replaceStart + replaceLength <= size; items have
non-empty label and insertText; every item matches the typed part of the word ([replaceStart, caret), minus a
leading '[' or '"') as a case-insensitive prefix of its label or of its insertText minus a leading '['.
